steps.title: Lesson 2: Core Concepts
steps.body: Key Fact: Studying families: sensitive topics (divorce, domestic violence). Questionnaires miss depth; interviews capture experiences but may distress; observations are intrusive. Official statistics provide marriage/divorce rates. | Key Fact: Studying education: access requires permission (gatekeepers). Questionnaires survey many quickly; interviews explore experiences; observations see classroom dynamics (Hawthorne effect); statistics show exam results; documents include Ofsted reports. | Key Fact: Studying crime: victim surveys capture unreported crime; self-report studies reveal hidden offending; observations study deviant subcultures (ethical issues); statistics are readily available but distorted; field experiments test discrimination. | Key Fact: Choosing methods: practical (time, m
